accumulator_contract.commit: one 96-lane vector per valid row/output block, serialized and charged equally to candidate and fixed8 baseline
accumulator_contract.finite_width_basis: M41 dense INT8 bound requires 21 signed bits; 24 signed bits selected
accumulator_contract.lazy_clear_or_epoch_tag: required to avoid a dense initialization sweep
accumulator_contract.port_contract: one vector read plus one vector write per accepted update; one global update result per cycle maximum
accumulator_contract.same_address_next_cycle_hazard: structurally absent: PWP results are separated by at least three service tokens; correction rows are unique within a key and key changes insert three load tokens
accumulator_contract.storage_implementation: macro required; not included in logic-only RTL

precompacted_input_contract.correction_events: M106 receives lossless precompacted event descriptors; natural-raster scan/compaction is outside this service island
precompacted_input_contract.pwp_requests: PWP request stream is available independently while the selected M106 descriptor bank fills
precompacted_input_contract.shared_service_lane: PWP beats and M104 load/event tokens are serialized
